title: A morphism is universally injective exactly when its diagonal is surjective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is universally injective if and only if its diagonal is surjective (author lemma at source lines 2906-2920, label lemma-universally-injective). The proof (source lines 2922-2974) rewrites the diagonal as the base change of itself along the identity section, applies the field-valued criterion for surjectivity of morphisms of algebraic spaces, and translates the resulting pointwise condition into the equality of points with common image, which is universal injectivity (proof lines 2923-2972). The reformulation of the diagonal and the translation of surjectivity into the defining condition on points are the content. H3.
